title: macaranga digyna
intro: Macaranga digyna, commonly known as "Pali," is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family and is native to Southeast Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Macaranga digyna include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant also include treating various ailments, such as diarrhea, rheumatism, and skin conditions, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
